Target sizes, gaps and token values are measured by ui-polish; this review judges whether the user can complete the task. ## UX review: note form Reviewed: the code of one form (textarea, Save note button, message line) and its save function. Layout input: none. Main goal: save a short note Steps to main goal: 1 (Note form) Findings: 2 (S1: 1, S2: 0, S3: 1, S4: 0) ### Findings 1. **Note form, save function and message line** | S1 Blocker | R-ux-review-6 - Evidence: "document.getElementById("msg").textContent = "Note saved";" - Shown absent: The function has no error message and no check of the server answer, so "Note saved" follows every request. - User experiences: The user sees "Note saved" even when the server refused the note, or sees "Saving..." forever when the request fails, and leaves believing the note is kept. - Recommendation: Show "saved" only when the server confirms it, and otherwise show next to the button what went wrong and what to do, keeping the typed note. 2. **Note form, message line under the button** | S3 Minor | R-ux-review-3 - Evidence: "

" - Shown absent: Nothing resets or changes the message when the user edits the note after saving. - User experiences: The user edits the note after saving, and "Note saved" stays on screen although the new text is not saved. - Recommendation: Clear or change the saved message as soon as the note differs from what was saved, so the screen shows whether the current text is saved. ### Not reviewed - Contrast, focus styles, spacing and type scales: a visual polish pass. - Semantics, ARIA and screen-reader output: an accessibility audit. - Wording of labels and messages: a copy edit. ### Open questions - Save note button: nothing shown says that its size or the gap above it makes the user miss it or hit another control, and no sizes were judged. - Server at "/api/notes": what does it answer for an empty or too long note, and is a limit stated to the user before saving? - Note form after a save: should the textarea be kept or emptied, and is a second save of the same text meant to create a second note? - Save note button: can it be pressed again while "Saving..." is shown? The code does not show it being disabled. ### Severity scale - S1 Blocker: the user cannot complete the main goal, or loses data or money. - S2 Major: the user completes the main goal only after a wrong action, an error or a second attempt. - S3 Minor: the user completes the main goal at the first attempt, but more slowly. - S4 Note: the result and the speed do not change; the place departs from the rule.
